span.p: Part 2's closing limitation — for continuous z, the likelihood is completely intractable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p:
§1–2 same data, three increasingly expressive p(x)
K-Means (Voronoi) → GMM (K learnable Gaussians) → neural generative model

div.style: color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(237, 230, 215) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §4 same ELBO logic as GMM/EM, now via Jensen: log p(x;θ) ≥ E_q[log p(x,z)/q(z|x)]

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §5 q(z|x) = N(μ_φ(x), Σ_φ(x)) — encoder (approximate posterior, not exact) · p(x|z) = decoder

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §6 reparameterisation z = μ + Σ^½ε makes sampling differentiable

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §7–8 reconstruction vs KL(q ‖ prior): a genuine tension · posterior collapse: too-powerful decoder ⇒ encoder ignores x

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §9 ✔ explicit, scoreable, stable · ✗ blurry samples · modern role: compress for latent diffusion (Stable Diffusion)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §10–11 implicit: z ~ q(z), x = G_θ(z) · density ratio via a binary classifier h(x): p(x)/p_θ(x) = h(x)/(1−h(x))

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §12–13 the optimal classifier computes Jensen–Shannon divergence ⇒ GAN objective = min-max JSD · discriminator estimates, generator minimises — a game

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §14 vanishing gradients: a good discriminator ⇒ ~0 gradient for the generator · non-saturating loss is the practical fix

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: §15–17 mode collapse: generator latches onto one mode · WGAN: Wasserstein distance varies smoothly even with no overlap · DCGAN fixes the architecture

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 260px; text-align: center; width: 260px;

span.p: modern role: style transfer, super-resolution; displaced by diffusion for raw sampling
